newsitem.title: DUBAI: Quake damages houses in southern Iran.
newsitem.headline: Quake damages houses in southern Iran.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.8 on the Richter scale damaged a number of houses in southern Iran but there were no reports of casualties, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Wednesday.

It said the Shiraz seismological centre registered the tremor's epicentre between the city of Firuzabad, 800 km (500 miles) south of Tehran, and Ghir-Karzin district at 10.10 p.m. (1740 GMT) on Tuesday.
A number of houses in the area were damaged but there was no report of any casualty, IRNA said.
Force four and five earthquakes are powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
Earthquakes hit Iran regularly. Nearly 1,000 people were killed by a quake measuring 5.5 in Ardabil in northwestern Iran in February.
